Will the PM convene experts to look at how rape myths are used in court. Burnham says he will establish a group to look at this.…

posts.text: Badenoch says the European Council has said that the tuition fees issue is linked to the three agreements announced on Friday, on food, emissions trading and youth mobility. If the EU does not accept the deal on tuition fees, will these deals go ahead? Burnham says the government is tomorrow bringing forward the…

Kemi Badenoch says, if EU students get reduced tuition fees to the UK, it will cost £500m. Who will pick up the tab? Universities or tax payers? Burnham says the deal is not yet done. And he defends the deal, saying it offers hope.

Darren Paffey (Lab) asks about care leavers’ month. He says Burnham provided free bus transport had free travel for care leaves. Will the government extend that around the country? Burnham says the previous mayor of Greater Manchester did have some good policies. He says he hopes other areas will adopt this policy.

Andy Burnham confirms he is making a statement about nuclear test veterans after this. And he confirms the government is bringing forward, to January, the date at which NDAs can no longer be used to silence victims.
